'''July 2000 Austin tournament (29 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin Sci-Fi Expo, Austin, TX on 29 July 2000. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1059">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-austin-tx-7-29-00d1059/ austin-tx-7-29-00], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 30 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-30-austin-tx-7-29-00d1059/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Austin Sci-Fi Expo, Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
